values: 一位掌控音律的游侠，擅长在战斗中演奏各种曲调来击败敌人。
A Rogue who commands the power of melody, capable of defeating enemies by playing different tunes.
既然不懂得如何保持安静，那就让我来教你吧。
Since you don't know how to stay silent, let me show you.
完美的谢幕。世界清静了。
A flawless finale. The world is quiet.
看来……我们可以合奏一曲。
We may weave our melodies together.
The wind carries a restless note.
All things... move to their ordained rhythm.
每根羽毛，都有它该在的位置。
Each feather belongs in its place.
I'm grateful you have entrusted it to me.
抱歉，我正在演奏，腾不开手……
Forgive me, I'm playing right now. My hands are full...
嗯……的确是一处优雅的居室
Mm... This is a most elegant residence indeed.
一切都好，只是少了点音乐
This area only lacks a bit of music.
食物都精致可口，茶也浓酽
The food is exquisite, and the tea is rich.
在成为半神前，奥菲戈斯是部族最为优秀的战士、猎蛇人、以及乐师。
Before becoming a Celestial, Sylphira was the most accomplished warrior, snake hunter, and musician of her tribe.
奥菲戈斯的手爪尤为灵活，这让她在演奏乐器时得心应手。她几乎精通所有乐器，即使遇到没见过的乐器，也能在极短时间内学会。
Sylphira's exceptionally dexterous claws make her a natural musician. She has mastered nearly every instrument and can pick up unfamiliar ones with remarkable speed.
奥菲戈斯非常爱惜自己的羽毛，每天都会花费大量时间精心打理。在她看来，保持仪表的整洁与完美，是践行优雅的第一步。
Sylphira adores her feathers, spending hours each day meticulously grooming them. To her, elegance begins with maintaining a neat and flawless appearance.
在所有羽毛中，奥菲戈斯最引以为傲的是她头枕处的冠羽。据说她曾为了保养这些羽毛，特意四处搜罗珍稀的香膏与精油。
Sylphira's greatest pride lies in her crest feathers. She is said to have journeyed far to procure rare balms and essential oils for their care.
奥菲戈斯自然拥有翱翔天际的能力，但她却鲜少展翅。只因在她心中，唯有靠近地面，才能近距离聆听自然优美的乐声，捕捉大地谐调的韵律。
Though blessed with the ability to fly, Sylphira rarely takes to the skies. To her, only by staying close to the earth can she truly hear nature's music and feel the rhythm pulsing through the land.
无论是咳嗽、打断还是任何形式的噪音，在奥菲戈斯演奏期间都是绝对的禁忌。对她而言，这不仅是无礼，更是对优雅艺术的亵渎。
Any form of noise, whether coughing or talking, is strictly forbidden during Sylphira's performances. She deems such behavior not just rude, but an affront to art itself.
伊索米亚流传着许多署名不详却极负盛名的古典乐章，其实多出自奥菲戈斯之手。她偶尔会兴起，在苦思冥想的凡人音乐家入睡后，于他们的乐谱上悄悄留下一点神来之笔。

Many of the anonymous classical masterpieces cherished across Esperia are, in truth, Sylphira's creations. Occasionally, she amuses herself by leaving strokes of genius on the unfinished works of sleeping mortal musicians.
除音乐外，奥菲戈斯对舞蹈也颇感兴趣。虽然萨基塔里斯多次怂恿，但奥菲戈斯的兴趣只限于欣赏，而非亲自尝试。
Sylphira's interests extend beyond music to dance. Yet despite Dionel's persistent encouragement, she remains content to watch rather than join in.
每当宴会上其他半神讨论起塔琳的近况时，奥菲戈斯不会主动发问，却总会不动声色地停下手中的动作，竖起耳朵仔细倾听。
Whenever the other Celestials mention Talene at banquets, Sylphira never asks about her, yet she always pauses what she is doing to listen intently.
亚莉克希曾经提议与奥菲戈斯来一场飞行速度的比拼，当然，这一提议被奥菲戈斯毫不留情地拒绝了。
Aliceth once challenged Sylphira to a flying race, but Sylphira refused outright.
奥菲戈斯，你拒绝了我的宴会邀请，却出现在了梅林这里。
Really, Sylphira? You turn down an invitation to my banquet only to turn up here at Merlin's?
萨基塔里斯 & 奥菲戈斯
嗯……的确是一处优雅的居室
Mm... This is a most elegant residence indeed.
食物都精致可口，茶也浓酽
The food is exquisite, and the tea is rich.
